prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet adoption: Defer account sign-in until after users choose and customize their desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive pet preview cards: Redesign pet selection with a split layout showing animated pet previews and sound clips.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose your desktop companion", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_anim"}]}}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop controls quick guide: Insert a new onboarding step showing how to click, move, hide, and interact with the pet on desktop.
   config: {"new_desktop_guide": {"headline": "How to interact with your desktop pet", "body": "Click to pet, right-click for options, or drag to reposition anywhere on your desktop screen.", "layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:desktop_controls_demo"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got it!", "action": "next"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_guide", "home_intro"]}
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive waiting room with ready alert: Transform waiting time into an interactive mini-pet preview arena with progress timer and background completion alerts.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing your pet's new home...", "notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mini_pet_game", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "timer", "label": "Estimated time"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing account account recovery hint: Display an informative prompt on sign-in clarifying how returning users can recover previously adopted pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already adopted a pet? Sign in with your original account to restore your pet and progress."}}
5: [choose_path, layout] Grid layout for creation path selection: Switch path selection to a structured grid layout clearly separating ready-to-adopt pets from photo creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "How would you like to meet your pet?"}}
6: [adoption, wait_info] Photo upload quality tips: Add photo guidelines and delayed tip popups detailing supported photo lighting and angles.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload a clear, front-facing photo with good lighting for best custom pet generation results.", "tip_delay_seconds": 5}}
7: [finish, incentive] Onboarding completion reward item: Display a desktop pet toy badge reward granted upon completing the final onboarding setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your pet is ready for your desktop!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "🎁 Free Desktop Toy Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Action-oriented intro call-to-action: Update story screen headline and button text to emphasize quick 2-minute adoption.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Adopt an animated pet for your desktop in under 2 minutes", "button_label": "Start Adoption"}}
9: [home, notification] Background generation desktop alert: Prompt users on waiting screen that they can safely minimize the app and get notified when ready.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize this window! We will notify you when your pet is ready on your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in to after pet adoption is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigning pet selection while keeping pet choices preserves the screen's core job.
Adding a desktop controls guide screen within onboarding is permitted.
Redesigning the waiting screen while keeping progress info for a real wait is allowed.
Adding account recovery copy to the sign-in step is allowed.
Updating layout while preserving both adopt and make-your-own options maintains the screen's core job.
Adding helpful photo upload guidance and tips is allowed.
Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'Free', violating Rule 3 which prohibits mentioning prices, gifts, or free extras.
Updating story headline and call-to-action text is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding background notification guidance to the waiting screen is permitted.
